GeneDef.label: construct psychology
GeneDef.description: Engineered neural architecture that suppresses social recreation, romance, and empathetic drama. The carrier operates with cold, single-minded devotion to their assigned tasks and security protocols.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Incapable of romance, marriage proposals, and social chatter.
Forces the Psychopath trait (indifferent to death, suffering, and corpses).
Suppresses social loneliness and recreation decay.
Colonists suffer zero mood penalties when this construct dies or is lost.

GeneDef.label: mandatory sterility
GeneDef.description: Enforces total biological sterility to prevent unauthorized reproduction, gene drift, and protect proprietary colony genetic investments.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Completely sterile. Cannot fertilize or be impregnated.

GeneDef.label: construct hibernation
GeneDef.description: This construct is engineered for high-intensity biological throughput: a 'flash in the pan' synthetic organism with rapid cellular senescence. Requires a mandatory 48-hour stasis cycle every 30 days to purge severe metabolic toxicity and defragment neural pathways. Halves natural lifespan.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Requires a 48-hour stasis hibernation cycle every 30 days.
Clean wake completely restores Rest and resets the 30-day operating limit.
Premature interruption inflicts interrupted stasis (neural defragmentation failure).
